text: Who had a key to the stable door?
why: The stable door was locked (¶31) and Holmes asks whether a duplicate key was found, so who had a key is a natural question.

text: Why take the horse out of the stable?
Why take the horse out of the stable? — to take him for early exercise
id: q.why_out=to take him for early exercise
why: In ¶34 the lads hoped the trainer had taken the horse out for early exercise.

text: Why take the horse out of the stable? — to steal him
why: The police theory (¶46) is that Simpson took the horse out to kidnap him.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning? — to injure the horse
why: Straker is presented as a zealous, honest servant who went out from anxiety; nothing yet suggests he meant to injure the horse.
